title: Region merge (a loop seam back to audio)
description: The one block that turns a region back into audio. Connect the body of a loop (optional) and the region (after its effects): the output is body plus region. With only the region connected it gives the processed region alone.

inputs.name: body
inputs.title: Body
inputs.description: The loop without its joins (the body output of import-audio). Optional.

inputs.name: region
inputs.title: Loop seam
inputs.description: The region to bring back, usually the loop seam after some effects.
